'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Bondi Beach shooting]]
**Two gunmen [[Mass shooting|open fire]] during a [[Hanukkah]] celebration at [[Bondi Beach]] in [[Sydney]], [[Australia]], killing 15 people and leaving 42 others injured. One perpetrator is killed, while the other is arrested. Two [[Improvised explosive device|bombs]] are found at the scene and detonated by [[New South Wales Police Force|police]]. *[[2025 Cambodia–Thailand conflict]]
**[[Thailand]] confirms that a rocket launched from [[Cambodia]] killed a Thai villager, the first civilian death in Thailand as a result of the ongoing conflict. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-border-conflict-rockets-4b3426dffcf3bf037d307038a23afd3a (AP)]

**[[Hamas]] Lieutenant Colonel Ahmed Zamzam is shot and killed by a gunman inside the [[Maghazi refugee camp]] in the [[Deir al-Balah Governorate]], [[Gaza Strip]]. The perpetrator is arrested. **Three people are killed in three separated [[Israel]]i [[airstrike]]s against vehicles in southern [[Lebanon]]. [https://today.lorientlejour.com/article/1488356/new-israeli-strike-in-southern-lebanon-hits-a-motorcycle-israel-destroys-several-construction-vehicles-in-southern-lebanon-live.html (''L'Orient Today'')]
*[[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|Syrian conflict]]
**Four [[Syrian Armed Forces|security force]] members are killed and another is injured in a [[mass shooting]] when gunmen open fire on a patrol in [[Idlib]], [[Syria]]. [https://www.trtworld.com/article/34570911a900 (TRT World)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Mass shootings in the United States]], [[School violence in the United States]]
**[[2025 Brown University shooting]]
***A person of interest is taken into custody for yesterday's [[mass shooting]] that killed two people and injured nine others at [[Brown University]] in [[Providence, Rhode Island|Providence]], [[Rhode Island]], [[United States]]. The person is later released from custody the same day, with authorities announcing that they are still searching for a suspect. *[[Crime in Guatemala]]
**[[Guatemala]]n [[President of Guatemala|president]] [[Bernardo Arévalo]] declares a [[state of emergency]] in two municipalities in western Guatemala a day after gunmen attacked a [[Armed Forces of Guatemala|military]] post and a [[National Civil Police (Guatemala)|police station]], cut off roads, and hijacked buses, killing at least five people. [https://halifax.citynews.ca/2025/12/14/guatemala-declares-state-of-emergency-after-armed-attacks-kill-at-least-5/ (CityNews Halifax)]
*[[Killing of Rob and Michele Reiner|Killing of Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner]]
**American filmmaker and actor [[Rob Reiner]] and his wife [[Michele Singer Reiner]] are stabbed to death at their home in Los Angeles, [[California]], [[United States]]. Their son, [[Killing of Rob Reiner and Michele Singer Reiner#Nick Reiner|Nick]], is later charged with the alleged murders.
